openwith.title: Open with
openwith.none: No app here can open this kind of file. You can download it instead.
openwith.always: Always use this app for {ext} files
openwith.hint.photo: Zoom, rotate, slideshow and camera details
openwith.hint.video: Subtitles, speed, picture-in-picture, resumes where you left off
openwith.hint.music: Queue, shuffle and repeat; keeps playing in the background
openwith.hint.text: Edit and save it as plain text
openwith.hint.quicklook: Shows the file in a simple window
openwith.hint.browser: Opens the file in a new tab of this browser
media.noPictures: There are no pictures next to “{name}”.
